message.content: The Declaration of Independence was officially adopted by the Continental Congress on **July 4, 1776**, but the formal signing of the document by the delegates took place on **August 2, 1776**. The July date is celebrated as the day the declaration was approved, while August 2 marks when the signatures were affixed.
